message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Run tests
run-name: ${{ github.actor }} testing freesasa
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - "master"
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master
concurrency:
  group: "${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}"
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  Test:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - CC: gcc
            CXX: g++
            enable: "--disable-json --disable-xml"
            deps: "libc++-dev libc++abi-dev"
          - CC: gcc
            CXX: g++
            enable: "--enable-check --enable-json --enable-xml"
            deps: "check libjson-c-dev libxml2-dev libxml2-utils libc++-dev libc++abi-dev"
          - CC: clang
            CXX: clang
            enable: "--enable-check --enable-json --enable-xml"
            deps: "check libjson-c-dev libxml2-dev libxml2-utils libc++-dev libc++abi-dev"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: "Check out code"
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Cache apt packages
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: /var/cache/apt/archives
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-apt-${{ matrix.deps }}-${{ github.workflow }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-apt-
      - name: "Install dependencies"
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -qq ${{ matrix.deps }}
          git submodule init
          git submodule update
      - name: "Configure"
        run: |
          autoreconf -i
          ./configure ${{ matrix.enable }} CC=${{ matrix.CC }} CXX=${{ matrix.CXX }}
      - name: "Build"
        run: make
      - name: "Test"
        run: make check
      - name: "Log errors"
        if: ${{ failure() }}
        run: |
          echo "\n>>> Test API log <<<"
          cat tests/test-api.log
          echo "\n>>> Test CLI log <<<"
          cat tests/test-cli.log
",
  "rationale": "Add concurrency with cancel-in-progress to avoid duplicate runs on the same branch/PR (supported by P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE experiment). Add caching of apt packages to speed up dependency installation (supported by P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern and experiment).",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-scenario-three-run-560f8aa17cf2dbe5", "experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE", "pattern:P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE"]
}
